symptom: An Image widget set to an icon (ImageType: icon) was described without the icon, and `Icon:` on an IMAGE was refused, so a describe round trip dropped the icon.
cause: image.def.json had no mapping for the `imageIcon` property and the widget engine had no source/operation for an icon value; describe's extractImageProperties never read imageIcon.
file: sdk/widgets/definitions/image.def.json, mdl/executor/widget_engine.go (Icon source, icon op), mdl/backend/widgetobj/builder.go (SetIcon), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_pluggable.go
insight: A pluggable widget property of type icon stores the same Pages icon element a button's Icon does (GlyphIcon Code / IconCollectionIcon Image), so both directions reuse the button helpers (buildWidgetIcon, extractButtonIcon, widgetIconMDL) — a new widget-def operation is the only new piece. The project's cached .mxcli/widgets def must be refreshed for an existing project to pick up a def change.
